overall_notes: The paper proposes GenQA (Generation-based QA) using supervision from automatic QA evaluation models (GAVA). It addresses answer generation (NLG task) and uses both automatic metrics and human evaluation. The main contribution is three training strategies: GAVA-SDA (Static Data Augmentation), GAVA-DDA (Dynamic Data Augmentation), and GAVA-LW (Loss Weighting). The extraction was generally accurate, with minor normalization needed for model names.
